bonePile.controlRule: If YOU already control that monster type, discard and redraw. Another player's copy of the same type is fine.
bonePile.data: Tile data declares it (boneSquare, 1,1 on all 41 tiles). Placement rotates it with the tile, so placement must use the ROTATED bone square, never the declared one and never a hardcoded square.
bonePile.definition: The marked spawn square on each dungeon tile. A position, not a pile anything accumulates in.
bonePile.effects: Scenario and card effects that name the bone pile place there (example: Strahd awakens on the start tile's bone pile; monster cards reading 'Spawn X on the bone pile of the newly revealed tile').
bonePile.encounterCardsUnverified: Encounter cards targeting bone piles (e.g. Grave Dirt, Idol of Strahd) are UNVERIFIED from the rulebook. Check card data before claiming any such effect; do not assume one exists.
bonePile.exploration: The monster drawn on exploration is placed on the new tile's bone pile.
bonePile.occupied: When the bone pile is occupied, place on an empty square on the same tile. (Placement convention per Louis's spec; the verified rulebook statement of 'if empty, else anywhere' is the tactics movement rule above.)
bonePile.rangeNote: Range is NOT measured bone-pile-to-bone-pile. Range is tile-to-tile.
bonePile.tacticsMovement: Move to the bone pile if empty, else anywhere on the tile.

combat.critical: A natural 20 is a critical hit and enables level-up spending (see experience).
combat.hit: d20 + bonus >= AC is a hit, per target.
combat.miss: Miss effects apply if listed on the card.

conditions.markers: At most one marker of each per hero. Markers discarded at end of Hero Phase.

downedHero: Figure stays knocked down on its square. Monsters ignore it. It cannot take damage or use powers/items, but conditions still apply. Healed before its turn starts, it stands up and acts normally.

experience.cancel: Spend XP cards summing to >= 5 (excess wasted) to cancel an encounter card, ONLY when drawn and before applying it.
experience.levelUp: On a natural 20 attack roll OR natural 20 disable-trap roll, spend 5 XP to level up: flip hero card, +2 HP, +1 AC, +1 surge value, gain a new Daily power and the critical-attacks ability.

game: Castle Ravenloft: The Adventure Board Game
manualGaps: Tile-stack exhaustion procedure: the rulebook text states no rule; do not invent one.
Encounter-deck reshuffle: the rulebook text states no rule; do not invent one.
Edge-matching on placement beyond the triangle sentence: the rulebook text states no rule beyond it; do not invent one.

movement.blocked: Cannot enter a wall square or a monster-occupied square. May pass through a hero's square but may not end there. No diagonal move between two adjacent walls.
movement.diagonal: Diagonal movement allowed, counting squares, unless blocked.

otherActions.destroy: Destroy objects: target like a monster if the object has AC/HP.
otherActions.disableTrap: Disable traps: on the trap's tile, instead of attacking, roll >= the disable number. A natural 20 also enables level-up spending.
otherActions.escape: Escape: on a specified location at end of Hero Phase. The hero takes no more Hero/Exploration actions and draws no more encounters, but still takes Villain Phase turns as applicable per scenario.
otherActions.pickUp: Pick up objects: adjacent, Hero Phase, no action cost, any number, even while passing.

powers.dailyUtility: Daily and utility powers flip face-down after use until an effect flips them back.
powers.timing: Utility timing (reactions vs hero-phase use) follows the card text.

rulebook: Official Castle Ravenloft rulebook (Wizards of the Coast, Renegade reprint, same rules text), verified in RULES_SWEEP_2026-10-24.md

surges.noneLeft: No surges at a 0-HP turn start means defeat.
surges.start: The group begins with TWO shared surge tokens (1 for harder variants, 3 for easier).
surges.use: A hero at 0 HP at turn start MUST spend one (regain surge value, then act normally).

treasure.Blessings: Play immediately, affect all heroes, discard at end of next Hero Phase.
treasure.Items: Drawing hero chooses the keeper on draw. Items cannot be re-gifted. Only one attack bonus and one defense bonus from items apply at a time.
treasure.defeatedMonster: Defeated monsters go to the controller's Experience Pile (their card is discarded to it).
treasure.drawCap: A hero who defeats a monster draws at most ONE Treasure Card per turn.

turnStructure.rule: 0-HP surge check: a hero at 0 HP MUST spend a surge if one is available, regains surge value, then acts normally. No surges left means defeat.
Exactly one of Move+Attack, Attack+Move, or Two Moves. Slowed/Immobilized markers discarded at end of Hero Phase.
Only if on an unexplored edge space: draw ONE tile, place triangle toward that edge, place a monster on its bone pile. Otherwise skip to Villain Phase.
Encounter draw ONLY if no tile placed OR black-triangle tile placed.
Villain activation, each villain one at a time.

Activate each monster/trap in draw order, following tactics (ordered list, first true applies, then turn ends; same-name monsters each activate, including another player's). Newly placed monsters act in this same Villain Phase.
Flags reset, next hero's turn begins.

winLoss.lose: A hero at 0 HP at turn start with no surges remaining (and all heroes down), or an adventure-specific defeat condition (example: 5 monsters escape in adv09).
